name: Agents Widget
tagline: Model, context, cost and usage for your coding agents.

screenshots.alt: The Agents widget with two gauges, Opus 5.5 at 42% and GPT-5.5 at 18% (sample data)

sections.heading: What your agents are doing
sections.body: A gauge in your terminal shows the model, context, cost and usage of Claude Code, Codex and Cursor Agent sessions. It is in beta: Codex and Cursor readings have not yet been validated against live accounts.
bullets: Per-agent switches in the widget settings
Place it anywhere and choose a presentation style
Local token analytics and spend breakdowns are not available yet
